headline: Floor Boss's fast taps now teach out loud
lede: The 24-check regression on main is fixed at its root: a refusal your thumbs hit between frames obeys the board AND says its name — banners, lessons, stamps and sounds all ring at the tick that banks the tap.

notes.text: #2992 root-caused and shipped (PR #2995, main 26b8b13, prod-verified): #2966's drain applied banked taps before step(), but step() wipes the event queue at entry — every fast-tapped refusal landed silently. The drain tick now rings its tap's fresh events; floorbossplay is 110/110 again (was 86/110).

New leg law: real-tap harnesses wait pending() === 0 (the bank drained, verdict in) instead of guessing a sleep — the 90 ms waits were click-time-apply-era calibration racing the drain on software-rendered frames. Mutant --mutate-ring kills the ring law by name.

Honest gap filed, not silently fixed: the solo-tap path still echoes the previous tick's backlog into handleEvents. It is now the shelf's weakest stage and the next lane's honest kick — the board's KICK FLOOR BOSS 0 weak at close is real work, not marker noise.

Ops: rule-5 merge exit lied again through the #2975 local-main squat (merge verified via PR state + origin/main + Vercel success). Contra files found dirty in the plumbing checkout from live QA work — reported in STATE.md, left untouched; that lane should clean up.
